summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting across login  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no code changed)  The watchlist backend actually looks correctly scoped on paper: - `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` has a `user_id` NOT NULL column. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` filters every read/write/delete by `user_id`. - The client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`) uses the shared `api` wrapper with `credentials: "include"`, so cookies are sent — no localStorage/anonymous fallback exists anywhere in the client.  So this is **not** an obvious "hardcoded default watchl
